lessons.title: Strong Shapes III: Triangles Don't Collapse
lessons.focus: Push a square frame vs a triangle frame; roof trusses, tank stands, bicycle frames; add diagonals to fix wobbles.
lessons.advanced: Count members needed to triangulate a square and a pentagon frame; state the rule (triangulation).

lessons.title: Beams and Cantilevers
lessons.focus: Ruler overhang records; top stretches, bottom compresses; I-beam and bamboo-split demos; shelf brackets.
lessons.advanced: Doubling beam depth quarters the sag (rule of thumb): explain with the stretched-top/compressed-bottom model.

lessons.title: Tension vs Compression: Reading a Structure
lessons.focus: Rope vs pillar; label every member of a tank stand and a truss as T or C; sponge-beam clues.
lessons.advanced: In a simple truss under central load, which members are in tension? Prove by 'removing' each mentally.

lessons.title: Centre of Gravity and Stability
lessons.focus: Wide base + low CG = stable; topple bottles vs sufurias; line-of-action falling outside the base.
lessons.advanced: Tilt angle to topple: compute for a box 40 cm wide, CG 50 cm high; compare with a wide jerrican.

lessons.title: Balance Acts: Loads on Heads, Bodas and Carts
lessons.focus: Revisit head carrying with CG reasoning; mkokoteni load over the axle; high loads on boda carriers; safe loading rules.
lessons.advanced: Design the loading plan for a mkokoteni carrying 100 kg of mixed goods; justify by CG and axle moments.

lessons.title: Bridge Challenge I: Design Brief
lessons.focus: Span 50 cm between desks, hold 1 kg at midspan, sticks/straws/string/glue only; sketch, triangulate, predict failure point.
lessons.advanced: Predict the failing member and its T/C nature; estimate your bridge's strength-to-weight ratio.

lessons.title: Bridge Challenge II: Build
lessons.focus: Construct to the drawing; log changes and reasons; weigh materials used (efficiency counts).
lessons.advanced: Keep a build log entry for every design deviation with a physics justification.

lessons.title: Bridge Challenge III: Test and Autopsy
lessons.focus: Load to destruction with sand bucket; record max load and failure mode; crown strength-to-weight champion.
lessons.advanced: Compute each bridge's strength-to-weight ratio; analyze the champion's geometry and write the design rule.

lessons.title: Tower Challenge: Tallest Stable Structure
lessons.focus: Paper/straw tower must stand 10 s in a fan breeze; base width vs height; guy ropes allowed or not?
lessons.advanced: Estimate the overturning moment from wind at 5 m/s on your tower face; size the base by moments.

lessons.title: Foundations and Soil: The Ground Is a Material Too
lessons.focus: Compact vs loose soil bearing; why buildings crack unevenly; mud vs stone footings; simple bearing test with a weighted shoe box.
lessons.advanced: Compute safe footing width: house wall 20 000 N per metre on soil bearing 100 kPa.

lessons.title: Materials and Climate: Thatch vs Mabati and Maintenance
lessons.focus: Thatch insulates, mabati lasts; rust, rot, termites; maintenance schedules as applied physics.
lessons.advanced: Lifecycle analysis: thatch every 5 years vs mabati once — compare 30-year cost and comfort with numbers.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Structure Expo
lessons.focus: Bridges and towers on display with failure stories; materials quiz stations; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Write the expo caption for your build: forces carried, failure mode found, one improvement.
